changes: Built with its own PyInstaller bootloader, so Windows Defender is less likely to mistake chudQ for malware
The app's code is public: github.com/maNobly/chudq-app
Champ select chat on chudq.lol says who wrote each line by lane and champion ("Bot · Jinx") instead of "Teammate"
A stream left running after chudQ restarted (an update mid-game) stops after the game again, instead of showing black on chudq.lol
Champ select team chat shows on chudq.lol (the lines weren't picked up)
Your gold on chudq.lol updates every few seconds instead of lagging up to 15 seconds behind
Your team's champ select chat shows on chudq.lol with the picks and bans
"Check for updates" at the bottom of the window, and chudQ looks by itself whenever you bring the window up
Fixes a black stream on laptops with two graphics chips: if the game shows up black for 30 seconds, chudQ switches to Windows' own capture by itself
Smoother updates: download progress, the installer's progress bar while it installs, and an "Updated" note with what's new when chudQ opens again
Quit in the tray menu closes chudQ completely (it kept running hidden)
Checks for a new version every time you open the window
Champ select timer on chudq.lol stays right when a new turn starts
No more "OBS is not ready" for a few seconds when chudQ starts OBS
The stream quality dropdown opens in chudQ's own style instead of Windows' grey list
The window looks like chudq.lol: same colours, fonts and buttons
A nicer stream quality dropdown
Champ select shows on chudq.lol: your team's picks and bans, live, before the game starts
Updates from inside the app: see what's new, then one click and it installs itself
Fixed the live data stopping in the Practice Tool (the target dummy)
"All PC sound" switch: stream Discord and music along with the game
